serviceDescription:
TACIT Watch monitors APIs/sites for availability, latency, content & schema changes.
Modes: status (HTTP codes), content (data changes), schema (JSON structure), latency (speed limits).
Params:
url (req): Target HTTP/S URL
checkType (req): status, content, schema, latency
intervalMinutes: Polling rate (default 5)
threshold: Value limit
webhookUrl: Alert endpoint
Example: POST /api/watch {"url":"https://api.github.com","checkType":"status"}
Use: Track production APIs, NFT drops, site health.
